import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)

memo = {}

def solve(n):
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    if n in memo:
        return memo[n]

    # generate repunits until distance starts increasing
    x = 1
    last_diff = abs(x - n)
    i = 0  # number of multiplications performed
    while True:
        x = x * 10 + 1
        i += 1
        new_diff = abs(x - n)
        if new_diff > last_diff:
            break
        last_diff = new_diff
    # after loop, x is the repunit that caused the increase
    # the repunit that gave the minimum diff is x // 10
    rep = x // 10
    steps = i  # number of multiplications to get rep

    if rep > n and rep // 10:
        prev = rep // 10
        res = min(steps + solve(abs(rep - n)), steps - 1 + solve(abs(prev - n)))
    else:
        res = steps + solve(abs(rep - n))
    memo[n] = res
    return res

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    print(solve(n))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
